name: The Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: The Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde was written by Robert Louis Stevenson, first published in 1886.
A respectable doctor's experiment unleashes his darker alter ego -- a short, tightly written novella that gave English the phrase "Jekyll and Hyde."
Discussion prompt: Duality of Human Nature is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
Read at your own pace this week; use today's video as background before or after your reading session.
